signalTypes.definition: Repeated lesson about a specific post type or its paired skill.
signalTypes.evidenceMinimum: single observation allowed; repeated observations required for canon or skill changes

signalTypes.definition: Repeated lesson about image, video, scene, asset, or prompt-template production.
signalTypes.evidenceMinimum: single observation allowed; repeated observations required for canon or skill changes

signalTypes.definition: Campaign postmortem lesson that is not yet durable campaign canon.
signalTypes.evidenceMinimum: campaign close or repeated campaign pattern

signalTypes.definition: Marketing-specific publishing workaround that may become channel canon, scheduler work, or a capability gap.
signalTypes.evidenceMinimum: single blocker allowed when paired with capability-work; otherwise repeated pattern

actionSelection.observe: Write the typed observation with source, affected surface, evidence count, and target direction.
actionSelection.promote-to-canon: Raise the relevant owned decision after evidence is stable enough to change a plan-of-record doc.
actionSelection.skill-edit: Route to the paired skill owner when the lesson is executable procedure.
actionSelection.capability-work: Raise capability-work when missing tooling blocks the work.
actionSelection.retire: Mark or remove the observation when it is obsolete, duplicated, or superseded.
